name: Asana
summary: Work management for team projects and tasks.

flows.title: Create a task
steps: Click the + Create button in the top bar. Inside a project, click + Add task at the top instead, or + next to a section.
Write a clear task name that says what needs to be done.
Click the Assignee field and type the name of the person who should do the work.
Click the calendar icon to set a due date, add a description with any context, and add collaborators who should stay in the loop.

flows.title: Find work with search
steps: Use the search bar in the top bar. The results list the tasks, projects, portfolios, messages and goals that match.
When there are too many results, use advanced search to narrow them by completion date, assignee, custom fields, task creator and more.
To keep a search you run often, click the star icon next to the search's name. A saved search updates every time it is opened.

flows.title: Complete a task
steps: Open the task and click Mark complete. Completing a task does not delete it or remove it from its project.
If completed tasks are hidden, set the project's filter to Completed tasks, or remove the filter.
To reopen a completed task, click ✓ Completed in the task pane.
